description: This file defines the ImageEffectInterface interface for image effects in Drupal, specifying methods for applying effects, transforming dimensions, getting derivative extensions, summaries, labels, UUIDs, weights, and setting weights.

classes.name: ImageEffectInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface for image effects in Drupal, including methods for applying effects, dimension transformation, derivative extension, summaries, labels, UUIDs, weights, and weight setting.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies an image effect to the image object.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Determines the dimensions of the styled image without performing actual image operations.

methods.name: getDerivativeExtension
methods.description: Returns the extension of the derivative after applying this image effect.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Returns a render array summarizing the configuration of the image effect.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the unique ID representing the image effect.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the image effect.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for this image effect.
